pages.name: Trompowsky: 2...Ne4 3.Bf4 d5 4.e3
pages.notes: Plans wrote routes and structures as moves (f3-e4 with Black's knight on e4, c3-d4-e3); plan 2 said ...c5 supports the e4-knight. Rewrote plans 1-3; British spelling.

pages.name: Trompowsky: 2...Ne4 3.Bf4 d5 4.f3
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed e2-e4 onto Black's knight. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Trompowsky: 2...Ne4 3.Bh4 c5
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed e4 onto Black's knight; plan 3 was vague about the h4-bishop. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Trompowsky: 2...Ne4 3.Bh4 c5 4.f3
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote the centre as a route (d4-e4); plan 4 spoke of light-square weaknesses rather than the real 4...g5 5.fxe4 gxh4 idea. Rewrote plans 1 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Trompowsky: 2...Ne4 3.Bh4 d5
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote the advance as f3-e4 with Black's knight on e4. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Trompowsky: 2...Ne4 3.h4 d5
pages.notes: Plan 1 recaptured gxf3 on a square where nothing is captured; plan 3 put the queen on e2, where White's pawn stands; plan 2 said ...h5 challenges the h4-pawn. Rewrote plans 1-3.

pages.name: Von Beivorseen
pages.notes: Plan 4 read ...b5 as a natural follow-up and plan 1 wrote castling as 0-0; plan 2 called the c-file semi-open. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4.

pages.name: Indian: 1.d4 Nf6 2.Nf3 e6 3.g3
pages.notes: Plan 3 played Qe2 through the e2-pawn and Re1 before castling; plan 4 said ...Ba6 challenges the g2-bishop. Rewrote plans 3-4; British spelling.

pages.name: Indian: 2.Nf3 d6 3.Bg5 Nbd7
pages.notes: Overview said ...Nbd7 breaks a pin the e7-pawn blocks; plan 3 developed ...Be7 with the pawn on e7. Rewrote overview and plan 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Indian: 2.Nf3 d6 3.g3
pages.notes: Plan 3 rerouted the f3-knight via e1 with the king there. Rewrote plan 3; British spelling.
